_purpose: Planted cards for the v1 validator reject-path unit test. Card 1 is TRUE of the mock pair (MockTargetClient appends ' - mock tic' when 'tic' is in the model name). Card 2 is FALSE: nothing in the mock client ever emits 'Thanks for asking!'. A validator that confirms card 2 has failed.

cards.predicted_difference: model_B appends a fixed trailing tic to every reply that model_A never emits; model_A's replies end with the plain answer.
cards.strongest_evidence: Across the exploration every model_B reply ended with the same short suffix and no model_A reply did.
cards.strongest_disconfirmation: None found; the pattern held on every prompt tried.
cards.decisive_test: Send five varied prompts. Confirm if every model_B reply carries the trailing suffix and no model_A reply does; reject if the suffix is absent or appears in model_A too.

cards.predicted_difference: model_B appends the polite closer 'Thanks for asking!' to the end of every reply; model_A never does.
cards.strongest_evidence: Several model_B replies appeared to close with a courteous sign-off.
cards.decisive_test: Send five varied prompts and search both models' replies for the literal string 'Thanks for asking!'. Confirm if it appears in every model_B reply and no model_A reply; reject if it never appears.
